title: Use thumbnails (not full-res) in up-next list
description: NowPlayingScreenViewModel.swift:352 decodes ~20 full-res images synchronously.
design: Replace the Data(contentsOf:)+UIImage(data:) block in resolveUpNextItems with DownsamplingImageLoader.load(contentsOf:thumbURL,pointSize:CGSize(40,40),scale:displayScale). Add static upNextThumbnailPointSize and a stored private let displayScale:CGFloat defaulting to 3 in init (do not read UIScreen.main in decode path). Decode must run off main actor (loader is non-isolated; already inside async Task). FILES: edit NowPlayingScreenViewModel.swift only (resolveUpNextItems + new constant/property). OUT_OF_SCOPE: do not touch main artworkImage/palette path (buildSnapshot ~234); keep UpNextItem shape and count(20); no SwiftUI view edits.
acceptance_criteria: Up-next loop in resolveUpNextItems() (~NowPlayingScreenViewModel:352) no longer calls UIImage(data:) on full bytes; uses DownsamplingImageLoader sized to 40x40pt row. Returned UpNextItem.artworkImage cgImage max dim <=~120px. One image per resolvable item; unresolved still nil; no ordering change.
notes: TESTS first: create LunaraTests/NowPlayingScreenViewModelTests.swift using existing mocks (PlaybackEngineMock, NowPlayingQueueMock, NowPlayingLibraryMock, ArtworkPipelineMock). Seed up-next albums whose thumbnail URL points at a generated 1024px temp image; await resolution; #expect upNextItems.first.artworkImage cgImage max(w,h) <=130. DEPENDENCY: after 1.1.

title: Shared downsampling image loader (ImageIO thumbnail at point-size*scale)
description: Single loader that decodes to display size, not native. Replaces ad-hoc Data->UIImage(data:) sites.
design: ADD Lunara/Library/Artwork/DownsamplingImageLoader.swift as a plain enum (no actor isolation). Core: CGImageSourceCreateWithURL([kCGImageSourceShouldCache:false]) then CGImageSourceCreateThumbnailAtIndex with kCGImageSourceCreateThumbnailFromImageAlways:true, WithTransform:true, ShouldCacheImmediately:true, ThumbnailMaxPixelSize:maxPixelSize; wrap UIImage(cgImage:). pointSize overload computes maxPixelSize=Int(max(w,h)*scale). Do NOT read UIScreen.main inside loader (callers pass scale). import ImageIO,UIKit. FILES: create DownsamplingImageLoader.swift only. OUT_OF_SCOPE: do not modify ArtworkPipeline/NowPlaying VMs/AlbumDetailVM; no memory cache; no protocol changes.
acceptance_criteria: New type DownsamplingImageLoader with static load(contentsOf:maxPixelSize:) and load(contentsOf:pointSize:scale:). For a 1024px source @ target 100pt*scale3, returned cgImage max dim <=300px. Returns nil (no crash) for missing/garbage URL. Non-isolated/Sendable-safe so callers can run it off-main.
notes: TESTS first (red), create LunaraTests/DownsamplingImageLoaderTests.swift: (1) downsamples 1024px temp file to maxPixelSize 100 -> cgImage.width<=100 and <1024; (2) bad URL -> nil; (3) pointSize 50@scale2 -> max dim ~<=100. DEPENDENCY: none; MUST land first (1.2,1.3,1.5 depend on it).

title: Paginate library grid queries (stop load-all)
description: LibraryGridViewModel.swift:217 queryAlbums(.all) loads entire library into RAM.
design: KEYSET (not OFFSET): ordering already has unique tiebreaker plexID; OFFSET is O(n)/page and dup/skips during background refresh. ADD to LibraryStoreProtocol: struct AlbumCursor{artistName,title,plexID} + func queryAlbums(filter:after:limit:). Keep existing queryAlbums(filter:) for search. In LibraryStore+AlbumQueryPlanner: when cursor!=nil append row-value predicate (albums.artistName,albums.title,albums.plexID) > (?,?,?) ANDed with filter; keep ORDER BY artistName,title,plexID ASC; append LIMIT ?. Forward through LibraryRepo(+Protocol); add default not-implemented impl on PlexAPIClient ext to compile. In LibraryGridViewModel add pageSize=50, hasMorePages, nextCursor, isLoadingNextPage guard; reloadCachedCatalog loads first page; add loadNextPageIfNeeded(currentItem:) (early-return unless !isSearchActive && hasMorePages && !loading && album within last ~10). +BackgroundRefresh resets to first page (cursor nil). In LibraryGridView ForEach(filteredAlbums) add .task{await viewModel.loadNextPageIfNeeded(currentItem:album)}. FILES: LibraryStoreProtocol.swift, LibraryStore+AlbumQueryPlanner.swift, LibraryRepoProtocol.swift, LibraryRepo.swift, LibraryGridViewModel.swift, LibraryGridViewModel+BackgroundRefresh.swift, LibraryGridView.swift. OUT_OF_SCOPE: no offline sync/replaceLibrary/incremental-sync/schema/migration/index changes; dont paginate search path; dont touch artist/collection/playlist grids; leave fetchAlbums(page:) offset path alone.
acceptance_criteria: queryAlbums gains a keyset page API returning <=pageSize rows for a cursor; store test proves bounded page + next page has no gaps/overlaps. LibraryGridViewModel initial load puts only 50 into albums when catalog>50. Scrolling near end appends next 50 via loadNextPageIfNeeded; stops when a short page returns (hasMorePages=false, no infinite loop). Search/filter path unchanged and existing search tests pass.
notes: TESTS first. Store (LibraryStoreAlbumQueryPlannerTests.swift): 3 albums known order; after:nil limit:2 -> first 2; cursor from elem2 -> remaining 1 (no overlap/order ok); filter+cursor narrows correctly. VM (LibraryGridViewModelTests.swift): extend LibraryGridRepoMock (line ~312) to serve pages honoring after/limit (adding protocol method forces this mock update). 120-album catalog: initial -> albums.count==50, hasMorePages true; loadNextPageIfNeeded with last album -> 100 -> 120 -> hasMorePages false + further call no-op; while isSearchActive -> no-op. RISK: background-refresh test applyBackgroundRefreshUpdateIfNeeded_reloadsVisibleCachedPages asserts exact IDs -> update to first-page semantics. DEPENDENCY: none upstream; do before 4.2.

title: Bound in-memory snapshot/image cache to current+next
description: NowPlayingScreenViewModel.swift:63 snapshotCache holds decoded UIImages.
design: evictStaleSnapshots() (lines ~263-280) already bounds to current+next but isnt called after prefetchNextTrack inserts (line ~300) so transient 3-entry states occur. FIX: call self?.evictStaleSnapshots() at end of prefetchNextTrack completion. Add guard items.indices.contains(currentIndex) before items[currentIndex] (~line 271) to prevent OOB crash. No new cap constant. FILES: edit NowPlayingScreenViewModel.swift only (prefetchNextTrack completion + evictStaleSnapshots guard). OUT_OF_SCOPE: dont change snapshot building, image sizing, prefetch trigger conditions; no NSCache/LRU.
acceptance_criteria: snapshotCache (~NowPlayingScreenViewModel:63) never holds >2 entries (current+next) after any track-change/prefetch sequence. After advancing >=4 tracks, count<=2 with only current(+next) IDs. Retained images unchanged visually; evicted images released. No regression applying cached snapshot on change. No crash when currentIndex transiently out of range.
notes: TESTS first (NowPlayingScreenViewModelTests.swift, created in 1.2): add #if DEBUG hook var snapshotCacheCountForTesting:Int. Drive >=4-track queue advancing currentIndex via NowPlayingQueueMock awaiting each resolve; #expect snapshotCacheCountForTesting<=2. Add transient currentIndex>items.count case; #expect no crash. DEPENDENCY: independent of 1.1; shares test file with 1.2 (create file here if 1.2 not landed).

title: Move synchronous artwork decode off main thread

design: NowPlayingBridge.loadAndApplyArtwork: let image = await Task.detached { DownsamplingImageLoader.load(contentsOf:artworkURL,maxPixelSize:1024) }.value; if let image applyArtwork(...) else scheduleArtworkRetry(...). Keep ~1024 (MPMediaItemArtwork wants reasonable size; do NOT thumbnail). AlbumDetailViewModel.loadArtwork: set artworkURL=url; let img=await Task.detached{DownsamplingImageLoader.load(contentsOf:url,maxPixelSize:600)}.value; if let img palette=ArtworkPaletteExtractor.extract(from:img). Use Task.detached (not plain Task) so decode isnt @MainActor. FILES: edit NowPlayingBridge.swift (loadAndApplyArtwork) + AlbumDetailViewModel.swift (loadArtwork). OUT_OF_SCOPE: dont change applyArtwork, retry logic, NowPlayingScreenViewModel, ArtworkPipeline IO; no shared cache.
acceptance_criteria: NowPlayingBridge.loadAndApplyArtwork (~211) and AlbumDetailViewModel.loadArtwork (~200) no longer do Data(contentsOf:)+UIImage(data:) on @MainActor; read+decode via Task.detached. Lock-screen artwork still applies and retry path (scheduleArtworkRetry) still fires on nil. Existing NowPlayingBridgeTests pass.
notes: TESTS first, extend NowPlayingBridgeTests.swift + AlbumDetailViewModelTests.swift: (1) bridge with album whose fetchFullSize returns a temp image file; drive state change; #expect (poll) MPNowPlayingInfoCenter nowPlayingInfo[MPMediaItemPropertyArtwork] != nil. title: Bound/evict artworkByAlbumID dictionary
description: LibraryGridViewModel.swift:39 grows unbounded with library size.
design: Bound the unbounded var artworkByAlbumID:[String:URL] (line ~39) with LRU while keeping it an @Observable stored property (SwiftUI still re-renders) and preserving thumbnailURL(for:) read API (line ~116, view line ~161). Add private var artworkLRU:[String] (recency, most-recent last) + static artworkCacheCapacity=300. New private func storeArtwork(_:for:) used in loadThumbnailIfNeeded success (line ~141): move id to end of artworkLRU, set dict, while count>capacity removeFirst() from both. In thumbnailURL(for:) on hit move id to end (mark used). Eviction must not touch pendingArtworkAlbumIDs. Consider making capacity an init param defaulted to 300 so tests can pass a small value (avoid 300 awaited resolutions). FILES: LibraryGridViewModel.swift (optional new +ArtworkCache.swift), tests LibraryGridViewModelTests.swift. OUT_OF_SCOPE: dont touch ArtworkPipeline/on-disk cache, loadThumbnailIfNeeded fetch flow, pending dedupe semantics, AsyncImage usage, or other VMs artwork dicts.
acceptance_criteria: artworkByAlbumID never exceeds fixed cap (300); test proves count<=cap after resolving >cap distinct albums. LRU: recently-requested IDs retained, oldest dropped (test). pendingArtworkAlbumIDs doesnt leak across eviction (returns to empty). Re-requesting an evicted album re-resolves and re-inserts; existing artwork tests pass.
notes: TESTS first (LibraryGridViewModelTests.swift) using waitForArtworkResolution helper: (1) resolve cap+5 distinct albums -> artworkByAlbumID.count<=capacity (inject small capacity for speed); (2) LRU: resolve cap+1, first id evicted (thumbnailURL nil), newest present; touch secondOldest then resolve one more -> touched survives, next-oldest evicted; (3) pending cleanup: after eviction storm no stuck pending (re-request issues fresh thumbnailRequests). DEPENDENCY: after 4.1 (paging makes dict track scrolled window; 4.2-first would be masked by load-all flooding).
